questions.question: A Hyderabad doctor significantly reduced the cost of tiratricol, a drug for which rare genetic disorder, benefiting seven children with free treatment?
questions.explanation: A Hyderabad doctor has significantly reduced the cost of tiratricol, a drug used to treat Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome (AHDS), a rare genetic disorder. questions.examRelevance: Hyderabad doctor reduced tiratricol cost for Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome (AHDS).
